entities.name: Andreas Hammerschmidt

entities.summary: Andreas Hammerschmidt was a German Bohemian composer and organist of the early to middle Baroque era. He was one of the most significant and popular composers of sacred music in Germany in the middle 17th century. He was nicknamed the "Orpheus of Zittau".
